description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the '/clients' API in the Apache Fineract project. It includes test methods to create a client and retrieve existing clients, along with utility methods to facilitate these actions.

classes.name: ClientTest
classes.description: Integration test class for the '/clients' API, extending the common IntegrationTest base class. Contains test methods for creating and retrieving clients, and utility methods for client ID handling.

methods.name: createOne
methods.description: Test method to create a client and assert the returned client ID is greater than zero.

methods.name: retrieveAnyExisting
methods.description: Test method to retrieve any existing client and verify it is present.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Utility method to retrieve the first client ID or create one if none exist.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Utility method to create a new client via the API and return its ID.

methods.name: retrieveFirst
methods.description: Utility method to fetch the first client in the list, returning an Optional containing the ID if found.
